frozen_at_note: Frozen before any fetch, backtest, or evaluation under this protocol (P0 of the plan's §9).

objective.central_question: Can a controller that jointly accounts for signal persistence, uncertainty in public data, and the retail cost of changing a position improve the return-drawdown-turnover frontier over simple, equally funded allocation rules?
objective.cagr_definition: CAGR = (N_end/N_start)^(365.25/elapsed_calendar_days) - 1 on a no-external-flow daily marked NAV path; initial NAV and terminal liquidation included.
objective.sharpe_definition: sqrt(252) * mean(r_t - rf_t) / sample_std(r_t - rf_t), rf aligned daily Treasury reference; zero-variance reported as undefined, never infinite.

acceptance_gates.rule: All minimum gates must hold jointly at the stated account size. Report the whole Pareto frontier; report a failed verdict if no candidate passes. Thresholds are not lowered after examining evaluation returns.
acceptance_gates.high_cost_case_rule: The doubled-cost stress must retain positive excess CAGR and Sharpe >= 0.5.

investment_contract.leverage: none at every fill and mark: nonnegative shares, nonnegative funded cash, risky market value <= NAV, reserve cash for fees and price movement before buys
investment_contract.decision_frequency: monthly reconsideration; daily risk and data-quality checks; risk-triggered rebalance allowed only through the same cost/funding/turnover ledger
investment_contract.settlement: model by trade date and exchange calendar; conservative cash-account simulation spends only settled funds; T+2 before 2024-05-28, T+1 from 2024-05-28

universe_candidate.status: illustrative candidate list; confirm product eligibility, inception, source coverage, and current terms before freezing actual membership
rules: Start each fund only after its true inception and sufficient observed history.
Do not extend an ETF backward using a yield series, spot commodity, or future index return.
Liquidity qualification uses trailing observations only; never future average volume.
Current-survivor ETF selection retains selection bias: label retrospective tests as conditional on that universe.

chronological_design.train_mode: expanding (rolling only if selected on inner folds)
chronological_design.label_purge: exact label-end timestamps for horizons up to 126 sessions; token one-day gaps are not accepted
chronological_design.carry_through_boundaries: holdings, costs, cash, signal warmups, and pending orders carry through outer boundaries; no free reset
chronological_design.prior_history_status: ALL dates used in prior repo model/strategy selection are development history, even if an old report calls them OOS; renaming dates or changing cutoffs does not restore independence
chronological_design.fresh_holdout_rule: A fresh historical holdout is valid only with evidence it has not informed selection; otherwise primary confirmation starts on the first eligible session after T0
chronological_design.evidence_minimums: >= 3 non-overlapping annual outer intervals for a preliminary study; >= 6 months and >= 6 scheduled rebalances of paper operation for mechanics; >= 24 prospective months for stronger evidence

trial_budget.scope: first study, excluding fixed mechanical stress replays
trial_budget.combination_rule: Combining winning parts of H1-H3 is an additional registered candidate, not a free uncounted improvement.
trial_budget.logging_rule: Log every candidate, failed run, manual rule change, and abandoned family.

H1_uncertainty_cost_hold_threshold.description: Auditable public-data uncertainty set combining forecasting error, release/revision ambiguity, and cost uncertainty in the same hold-versus-trade decision.
H1_uncertainty_cost_hold_threshold.ablation_expectation_pre_registered: Full data/cost uncertainty (d) reduces half-turn turnover by >= 20% versus cost-only no-trade bands (b), loses <= 0.5pp net CAGR, and does not worsen drawdown by > 1pp on development folds.

H2_persistent_holdings_turnover_budget.description: Rolling 252-session trading budget with persistence-based spending, account-size-aware minimum ticket fees, holding/settlement state, and competing demands.

H3_slow_risk_budgets_asymmetric.description: Slow allocation policy plus separate daily risk monitor with asymmetric shrink-fast/recover-gradual budget changes; 10% annual volatility budget; exposure multiplier min(1, target_vol/forecast_vol); 8% caution / 12% reduction drawdown thresholds with 20-session recovery rule.
H3_slow_risk_budgets_asymmetric.comparison: Against static allocation with no monitor-driven trading AND a matched static cash allocation.

half_spread_plus_slippage_per_side_bp.stress: double and triple both components; use larger observed values whenever available

stress: 25% of orders miss first eligible session under a seeded rule independent of returns

cost_model.commission_reference: IBKR Pro US whole-share schedule (Fixed USD 0.005/share min USD 1.00; Tiered <=300k shares/month USD 0.0035/share min USD 0.35; cap 1% of trade value) — reference example, not an assertion about the eventual broker
cost_model.formula_usd: C = commission(Q,D) + additional_fees + D*(h + l + Y*sigma*sqrt(rho))
rules: Use dated fee tables, not today's rates for all historical years; constant-current-schedule replays are labelled cost scenarios.
Impact embedded in simulated fill price is not subtracted again as a cash fee; implementation shortfall is not added to its own components.
Zero commission never means zero execution cost.

baselines.B0: Zero-interest cash; verified cash/Treasury reserve; equity buy-and-hold; conventional 60/40 equity/Treasury
baselines.B1: Capped equal-weight and fixed diversified allocation, monthly banded rebalance
baselines.B2: Fixed 126-session trend/relative-strength rule, long-only, monthly; cash when ineligible
baselines.B3: Shrinkage minimum-variance and capped inverse-volatility allocation, no borrowing
baselines.B4: Same forecasts plus fixed no-trade bands and realistic costs (primary control for incremental H1-H3 value)
baselines.A1-A3: Add each of H1/H2/H3 to B4 independently
baselines.A4: Registered combined controller and leave-one-component-out variants
baselines.selection_rule: Select the strongest simple control on inner development data, not the final test.

promotion_gates: 1. Integrity: free access/usage recorded, point-in-time inputs valid, no material unresolved prices/actions, ledger reconciles, no leverage or funding violations. Failure blocks the performance claim.

2. Historical research candidate: all minimum numerical gates hold jointly at the stated account size; >= 0.15 Sharpe improvement over the selected B4/simple control, <= 0.5pp CAGR sacrifice and <= 1pp drawdown deterioration, or a separately preregistered Pareto-improvement claim; report all folds.
3. Robustness: doubled-cost gate holds; delay/parameter/provider tests do not reverse the economic conclusion; tail shock losses shown.

4. Confirmation: on genuinely untouched/prospective data, paired uncertainty for the preregistered incremental metric; strong superiority requires its 95% block-bootstrap interval to exclude zero; otherwise retain 'inconclusive'.
5. Operational readiness: paper-run positions, cash, costs and orders reconcile; stale data, missed sessions, restarts and duplicate-order recovery exercised.
stop_conditions: If free historical data is inadequate, say exactly which fields/dates are missing and collect prospectively.
If realistic execution removes the edge, reject or simplify the strategy.
If no portfolio meets the simultaneous targets without leverage, publish the measured feasible frontier and retain the constraint.
Stop an unsuccessful family at its registered experiment budget and record why.
